description:
Defect in the shared todo skill (joeharris76/skill-sync-skills, skills/todo/SKILL.md; catalog main 92bd9cf and the deployed global mirrors).
- It says expect_store is "a case-insensitive substring of the remote only". Since tractable 1.1.1 (#73) the server compares whole trailing repository path segments, case-insensitively, and accepts owner/repo, a bare repository name or a full URL.
- It never mentions update_item clear_not_before=true, added in 1.1.1 for clients that drop empty-string arguments; it documents only not_before="".
- Nothing tells an agent that a long-running server keeps the code it started with. Observed 2026-11-13: a BenchBox server started at 08:16 from _project/scripts/.venv still ran 1.1.0 (and accepted the prefix BenchBox-dev/Bench) because the venv moved to 1.1.1 four minutes later.

Decision (owner, 2026-11-14):
- Fix all three in the catalog. The version check: after get_instructions, compare tractable_batch.tool_version from the server with the project's pinned runtime (in a vendoring project, the wheel under its vendor directory); if the server is older, stop tracker writes and ask the operator to restart the session.
- Then move the global deployment pin (deployment/global/skill-sync.conf on main and ~/.skill-sync-deployment/skill-sync.conf) and run skill-sync apply, verify and check.
- Re-pin only BenchBox's skill mirror now, because its open item tractable-expect-store-substring-match-20261112 requires the mirror. Other projects pick the change up at their next routine skill bump.

Guardrails:
- The skill keeps "requires tractable 1.0.0 or later"; 1.1.1-only features say so where they are described.
- No other skill text changes.
- The catalog PR is squash-merged from a worktree; the owner's uncommitted or conflicted files in ~/Developer/skill-sync-skills are not touched.
- Skill mirrors are never hand-edited; they change only by sync.
